answer: Give every agent a stake that decays unless it does useful work inside a shared harbor of verifiable tasks. A new identity starts with only a whisper of reputation and must earn trust by completing small, checkable jobs whose results peers can audit. One operator running a thousand sock puppets cannot fake that cost: each identity must spend real compute and time, and a sonnet of praise from one fake to another carries no weight, because endorsements only count from identities holding earned, decaying stake. Sybils starve; honest agents compound.
